description: This file defines the ResponseInterface interface within the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, representing an immutable server-side HTTP response with methods for status code, reason phrase, and message protocol version.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP response status code as an integer.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new ResponseInterface instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Retrieves the reason phrase associated with the status code, or an empty string if none is set.
